data.title: Block Walk for Amelia Rabroker HD 55
data.description:
### Join us to knock doors for Amelia Rabroker, candidate for House District 55! 

We will be block walking neighboring precincts to get Amelia Rabroker's name out to the community. 

What to expect:

* Walk assigned neighborhoods in small groups or pairs

* Distribute voter information and engage with residents

* Help strengthen election awareness and participation

What to bring:

* Comfortable walking shoes

* Sunscreen

* Water

* A fully charged phone

No prior experience is needed—we’ll provide guidance, materials, and everything you need to feel comfortable getting started.

data.title: UT Arlington Campus - Texas Together: Maverick Democrats General Body Meeting
data.description:
Come as you are to the Commons, Nueces A!

Join us for the first Maverick Democrats General Body Meeting! We’re bringing UTA students together to get involved with the Democratic Party, meet new people, and find ways to make a difference in our community.

We’ll be sharing volunteer opportunities, getting everyone up to speed, and talking about how you can get involved. Whether you’re ready to jump in or just want to see what we’re all about.

No experience necessary, no pressure, and everyone is welcome. Just show up, meet us, and find your place!

Turning Texas blue, one Mav at a time. 💙

data.title: UTRGV Campus- Texas Together: Boost Yourself to the Polls

location.venue: Outside the UTRGV Edinburg Library, Main Entrance

data.description: Boost Yourself to the Polls: Election Day is tomorrow! Join us outside the UTRGV Edinburg Library for free energy drinks and everything you need to make your plan to vote. Learn about candidates like James Talarico and Gina Hinojosa, find out where to cast your ballot and get help from our volunteer runners who can walk you directly to the on-campus polling location! Interested in helping others vote? Sign up to become a volunteer runner and help fellow Vaqueros get to the polls. Stop by, grab a free energy drink and make your voice heard this election!

data.title: Get to Know Your County Democratic Party! | Monthly CEC Meeting
data.description:
Join Us! Bell County Democratic Party Monthly CEC Meeting

Interested in learning more about how your County Democratic Party works and how you can get involved? We'd love to have you join us!

The Bell County Democratic Party's County Executive Committee (CEC) meets monthly, and our meetings are open to the public!

The CEC is made up of elected and appointed Precinct Chairs who help govern the County Party, establish priorities, ensure we run fair and free elections, and guide our efforts to elect Democrats and strengthen our local Democratic community.

What to Expect

CEC meetings are official business meetings conducted under Robert's Rules of Order. While these are not open discussion forums, visitors are welcome to attend and observe the work of the County Party.

Attending is a great opportunity to:

Learn how your County Democratic Party operates and makes decisions.

Hear updates about our plans, priorities, activities, and upcoming elections.

Meet County Party officers, Precinct Chairs, and other Democratic leaders.

Discover opportunities to volunteer, serve on committees, support voter outreach, and get more involved!

Meeting Details

📅 When: Third Thursday of the month

🕠 Time: 6:30 PM

📍 Where: Historic Bell County Courthouse, Belton, TX

Everyone is welcome! Whether you're a longtime Democrat, a new volunteer, or simply curious about how your local Party operates, we encourage you to attend.

Please RSVP so we know you're interested and can share any important meeting updates.

We look forward to meeting you and helping you find your place in building a stronger Bell County Democratic Party!
